author: Eddie Shaffer
text: We called Gross Family Plumbing Llc about an annoying drain backup affecting our whole house in Salt Lake City, and we were glad to get same day service. miguel arrived right on time and worked hard to make sure the clog and drainage issue were fully cleared. he worked fast, was very thorough with testing and retesting the flow, and checked that everything was draining the way it should before finishing. he was very respectful, explained the plumbing work in simple terms, and left the area clean with no mess behind. our bill was very reasonable, and we will definitely use them again for future plumbing service because the whole experience was smooth, professional, and handled really well.

author: marissa peck
text: Gross Family Plumbing LLC did stellar work for us on several plumbing projects in Salt Lake City. Miguel came back for more work and once again made a tough kitchen sink relocation look easy, even though it required opening part of the foundation to move the drain and water lines. I feel very confident the plumbing work is high quality and built to last. After dealing with other plumbers who had poor workmanship and missed appointments, Billy really listened, understood the urgency, and took the time to look over the job carefully. When the work started, Miguel fixed the plumbing issues that had been left behind and clearly explained what to watch for during the rest of the bathroom and kitchen work. That guidance helped a lot and made the whole process much smoother. Later, Miguel and Billy came back to finish the installation of the toilet, tub, shower, and sink faucets. Everything was completed in a timely way, the plumbing fixtures were installed neatly, and the work area was left very clean. The office staff was also courteous, knowledgeable, and patient throughout the scheduling and follow-up. I highly recommend them for quality plumbing work, good communication, and professional service.

author: Raymond F
text: I don’t usually post reviews, but Gross Family Plumbing LLC really impressed me. Billy and Miguel were excellent from start to finish. Billy gave me a very fair quote to repair my broken shower, and it came in a couple hundred dollars lower than the first estimate I got from another plumber. On the day of the job, they arrived on time, worked efficiently, and handled the shower repair with real skill and care. The work was finished faster than I expected, and the final bill was almost $300 less than the original estimate, which was a great surprise. They were professional, honest, and easy to work with, and they made the whole plumbing repair process smooth and stress-free. It is not always easy to find a reliable plumber in Salt Lake City, so I really appreciated their clear pricing, solid workmanship, and respectful service. I would gladly recommend them to anyone needing shower or household plumbing help.

author: S Sheppard
text: We contacted Gross Family Plumbing LLC to replace our old tank water heater with a tankless hot water heater, and the whole plumbing process went very smoothly. miguel came out first, checked our setup carefully, explained the options in simple terms, and even looked in the attic to make sure the existing water lines and venting would work well for the new unit. The quote came back lower than the other plumbing estimates we had received, which made the decision much easier. We were able to get the installation scheduled quickly because they had an opening, and that was a big help. On install day, billy and miguel worked fast and efficiently. From draining the old tank to finishing the final connections and putting the cover on the new unit, the job moved along nicely and looked very organized. They kept the work area clean, were respectful in our home, and made the whole water heater replacement feel stress free. Everything looks professionally done, and the new system is working great with strong hot water and better space savings. i really appreciated that all of our questions were answered clearly, and we never felt rushed. they also made it clear that if anything comes up later, we can call with questions. overall, this was a great experience, and we would definitely use them again for any plumbing needs in Salt Lake City.

author: Reagan Nixon
text: Great experience with Gross Family Plumbing LLC. Miguel was fast and thorough with the estimate and explained in simple terms what would work best for my plumbing setup. Billy and the crew did an excellent job installing my new water heater and updating the plumbing connections and related components. I work from home, and they kept interruptions to a minimum during the whole job. They were organized, professional, and made the full plumbing upgrade feel smooth and easy. I would definitely recommend them for water heater installation and plumbing work.
